branch_state.feature_branch_base_note: Branched from claude/perception-gateway (PR #5), NOT from main. See dependency note below.

working_tree_status_before_edits: clean (git status --short --branch showed only the tracking-branch line, no changes)

package_manager_evidence.python: no requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/lockfile at repo root; forgeworld-mobile-research/requirements.txt exists but is unrelated to this mission's target modules (router/, capabilities/, whatsapp/, governance/, perception/) -- confirms this repo's established zero-third-party-dependency-for-core-modules posture
package_manager_evidence.node: package.json present under pocket-cortex/ only; not relevant to this mission's Python-based target modules

database_technology: None. All persistence in the target modules is flat-file: JSON (capabilities/registry.json), append-only JSONL (capabilities/history.jsonl, router/decisions.jsonl, whatsapp/ledgers/*.jsonl, perception/ledgers/*.jsonl), and JSON config files (governance/policy_defaults.json, governance/revocations.json). No SQL/NoSQL database exists for these modules. pocket-cortex/ separately uses node:sqlite, but that module is unrelated to this mission's scope.

schema_and_migration_conventions.validation_style: Hand-rolled Python validation functions (no jsonschema package available; no dependency-management story exists in this repo) -- see whatsapp/src/schema.py and perception/src/schema.py, both new_x()/validate_x() pairs per object type.
schema_and_migration_conventions.migration_style: perception/src/migrations.py: register(object_type, from_version) decorator + migrate() function, no-op at current schema_version, raises on unknown version. No prior migration module existed before the Perception Gateway mission (PR #5).

test_framework.whatsapp/tests: stdlib unittest, run via 'python3 -m unittest discover -s whatsapp/tests -p test_*.py'
test_framework.perception/tests: unittest.TestCase classes, run via 'python3 -m pytest perception/tests -q' (pytest can collect unittest.TestCase; both styles coexist in this repo)

workflows.name: whatsapp-tests
workflows.triggers: pull_request paths=[whatsapp/**, .github/workflows/whatsapp-tests.yml]; push to main paths=[whatsapp/**]
workflows.job: whatsapp module test suite -- runs unittest discover, an offline-sanity network-block check, and a hardcoded-secret grep

ci_workflows.note: No CI currently covers tests/governance/, perception/tests/, router/, or capabilities/. This mission extends whatsapp-tests.yml's trigger paths and adds a job rather than creating a second, disconnected workflow file.

relevant_unmerged_branches: claude/perception-gateway (= PR #5; contains governance/, whatsapp/, perception/ -- none of which exist on main)
claude/forgeworld-authority-separation (merged into claude/perception-gateway already; governance/ origin)
